theater: 粵漢鐵路走廊與湘鄂贛戰區

battle.name: 北伐戰爭
battle.theater: 粵漢鐵路走廊與湘鄂贛戰區
battle.brief: 民國十五年七月九日，蔣中正在廣州誓師北伐，國民革命軍沿粵漢鐵路北進，次第打倒吳佩孚、孫傳芳與張作霖三大軍閥。汀泗橋、賀勝橋一線突破直系主力，十月二十七日武昌易手，武漢三鎮先後落入國民革命軍之手。卡面所配的三八式步槍是日軍制式步槍，在北伐後期奉軍的東北戰線上大量裝備，亦隨繳獲流散全國。

kit.name: 三八式步槍
kit.history: 三八式步槍是日本陸軍在二戰前的主力步槍，以其可靠性和精確度聞名，被廣泛用於步兵班及前線作戰。

countries: 北伐以廣州國民政府領導的國民革命軍為一方，以北方三個軍閥集團的聯軍為另一方。國民革命軍方面，一九二六年七月九日蔣中正在廣州黃埔誓師，總司令部之下設數個軍：第四軍由李濟深率領，是廣東方面的作戰主力；第八軍以譚延闓為軍長，收容湖南唐生智的湘軍為骨幹；第九軍由朱培德率領，指向江西方向；福建方向另有第十四軍等部。各軍番號與建制在出師後半年內屢有調整。部隊沿用黃埔軍校培訓出來的軍官體系，各軍設政治部與黨代表制度，蔣中正兼任國民革命軍總政治部主任，把黨務系統嵌進指揮鏈。地方實力派中，湖南唐生智於七月宣布響應，江西、福建、陝西等地亦陸續有軍隊倒戈加入；蘇聯派軍事顧問團駐廣州黃埔，並提供槍械、訓練與建軍方面的援助。北方方面，直系總司令吳佩孚盤據兩湖與河南，是北伐的首要目標；江浙皖閩贛等地的軍閥由孫傳芳以「五省聯軍」名義統合；奉系首領張作霖據東北與京奉線，控制北平與天津。吳、孫、張三系雖一度聯合對抗國民革命軍，但各懷私心、協同有限，戰局中彼此不能配合作戰，這正是北伐軍得以分進合擊、各個殲滅的前提。
countriesEn: The Northern Expedition pitted the National Revolutionary Army of the Guangzhou government against a coalition of the three northern warlord groups. On the government side, Chiang Kai-shek swore the army in at Huangpu, Guangzhou, on 9 July 1926, and the force was organised into several armies (jun). The Fourth Army under Li Jishen was the operational core from Guangdong; the Eighth Army under Tan Yankai absorbed Tang Shengzhi's Hunan troops as its backbone; the Ninth Army under Zhu Peide drove toward Jiangxi; and separate formations, including the Fourteenth Army, moved into Fujian. The numbering and structure of the units were adjusted repeatedly in the months after the army set out. The officer corps came from the Whampoa Military Academy, and every army carried a political department and a system of party representatives, with Chiang Kai-shek additionally serving as director of the Political Department of the National Revolutionary Army, so that party organisation was built into the chain of command. Among the regional strongmen, Tang Shengzhi declared for the expedition in July 1926, and troops in Jiangxi, Fujian and Shaanxi came over in turn. The Soviet Union stationed a military advisory group at Whampoa and supplied arms, training and help with the building of the army. On the northern side, Wu Peifu, commander-in-chief of the Zhili clique, held Huguang and Henan and was the first objective; the warlords of Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, Fujian and Jiangxi were welded into a single command by Sun Chuanfang under the title of the Five-Province Allied Army; and Zhang Zuolin, head of the Fengtian clique, held Northeast China and the Peking–Fengtian railway, and with them Peking and Tianjin. Wu, Sun and Zhang did at times combine against the National Revolutionary Army, but they distrusted one another and rarely fought in concert, and in the battle they could not support each other — which is precisely the condition that allowed the expedition armies to converge from separate lines and to destroy the enemy in detail.
people: 蔣中正是全役的策劃者。一九二六年七月九日在廣州誓師之後，他提出「先吳後孫再張」的總體方針：先取兩湖、消滅吳佩孚主力，再圖江西、福建、浙江，最後才北伐奉系。他同時主持北伐的政治工作與黨務，決定了一九二七年四月的清黨，以及寧漢分裂後的再次下野與復出；一九二八年的二次北伐仍由他出任總司令。譚延闓任國民革命軍副總司令兼第八軍軍長，統率湘軍，是兩湖方向的主要指揮者；李濟深任第四軍軍長，率廣東主力西進湖南；朱培德任第九軍軍長兼參謀總長，負責江西方向；曹浩森率第十軍攻略福建與浙江，進軍上海；周蔭人掌管福建一線的軍隊。葉挺以黃埔第四期出身，於一九二六年四月組建獨立團並自任團長，黨代表為廖乾五。獨立團以連為單位實施突擊，在汀泗橋、賀勝橋與武昌攻城中立下首功。北方的關鍵人物是吳佩孚、孫傳芳與張作霖：吳佩孚在汀泗橋、賀勝橋一線親率援兵反撲而未果，直系精銳自此崩解；孫傳芳在江西、浙江屢戰屢敗，最終退往長江下游；張作霖直到一九二八年才被迫放棄關內。趙登禹率第二師血戰武勝關，於一九二七年五月殉國。張學良、閻錫山在一九二八年先後順應形勢通電易幟，促成形式上的全國統一。
peopleEn: Chiang Kai-shek was the architect of the entire operation. After the oath-taking at Guangzhou in July 1926 he set out the overall plan — strike at Wu first, then Sun, then Zhang: seize Huguang and destroy the main strength of Wu Peifu, then take Jiangxi, Fujian and Zhejiang, and only afterwards march against the Fengtian clique. He also ran the political work and the party affairs of the campaign, and it was he who decided on the purge of April 1927 and on his own resignation and return after the Nanjing–Wuhan split; he was commander-in-chief again for the second phase in 1928. Tan Yankai was deputy commander-in-chief and commander of the Eighth Army, commanding the Hunan troops on the principal front; Li Jishen led the Fourth Army west from Guangdong into Hunan; Zhu Peide, commander of the Ninth Army and chief of the staff, was responsible for Jiangxi; Cao Haosen took the Tenth Army through Fujian and Zhejiang into Shanghai, while Zhou Yinren commanded the forces operating in Fujian. Ye Ting, an officer of the fourth Whampoa class, formed the Independent Regiment in April 1926 and commanded it himself, with Liao Ganwu as its party representative. Operating by company, the regiment led the assaults on Tingsi Bridge, Hesheng Bridge and the walls of Wuchang, and won the renown of the army. The decisive figures on the northern side were Wu Peifu, Sun Chuanfang and Zhang Zuolin. Wu personally brought up reinforcements against the advance at Tingsi and Hesheng and failed, and the Zhili elite broke from that moment onward; Sun was beaten repeatedly in Jiangxi and Zhejiang and finally withdrew towards the lower Yangtze; and Zhang Zuolin was not driven out of China proper until 1928. Zhao Dengyu led the Second Division in the bloody defence of Wushengguan and was killed there in May 1927. In 1928 Zhang Xueliang and Yan Xishan followed the trend of events and declared for the government in turn, bringing about the nominal unity of the country.
kits: 卡面所配的三八式步槍是一九〇五年定裝的日本陸軍制式步槍，口徑六點五毫米，五發彈匣，全長約一二七〇毫米，槍重約三點九五公斤，有效射程五百米，理論射速每分鐘十至十五發；槍身結構簡單、易於維修，長期是遠東產量最大、散布最廣的步槍。北伐期間，國民革命軍在兩湖、江西主戰線上的步兵主要裝備是漢陽兵工廠製造的仿德式步槍與國產中正式步槍，機槍多為德制七九二毫米重機槍的仿製品，砲兵以七五毫米級山炮為骨幹，迫擊炮以八二毫米為主。各軍裝備多由前任軍閥手中接收或購買，日造、德造、俄造、英造槍械並存，彈藥規格混雜，同一支連隊常常同時配發不同口徑的步槍，後勤極不統一。而奉系軍隊的槍械大宗來自日本，三八式步槍在奉軍中裝備數量極大，因此在一九二八年二次北伐打到東北的戰線上，成為最常見的制式步槍；北伐軍接收奉軍倉庫之後，這批武器又大量流入東北地方武裝，一直延續到九一八事變之後。除步槍之外，兩軍都大量使用手榴彈、地雷與輕機槍；攻城與反攻城作戰則依靠迫擊炮曲射壓制，機槍火力封鎖通道。騎兵部隊主要編在奉系與西北軍，國民革命軍則以火車與汽車運輸為主，粵漢鐵路成為全軍的補給命脈；少量飛機擔負偵察與對地攻擊，但規模有限。
kitsEn: The rifle on the card face is the Type 38, the standard infantry arm adopted by the Japanese army in 1905. It fires a 6.5 mm cartridge from a five-round magazine, measures about 1,270 mm in overall length, weighs about 3.95 kg, has an effective range of 500 metres and a theoretical rate of fire of ten to fifteen rounds a minute; its simple, easily serviced construction made it for a long time the most heavily produced and most widely distributed rifle in the Far East. During the Northern Expedition, the infantry of the National Revolutionary Army on the Huguang and Jiangxi fronts were mainly armed with the German-pattern rifles made at the Hanyang arsenal and with the domestically produced Zhongzhengshi rifle; the machine guns were largely imitations of the German 7.92 mm heavy machine gun; the artillery was built around 75 mm mountain guns; and the mortars were mostly of the 82 mm type. Equipment had been bought from, or taken over from, the preceding warlords, so that Japanese-, German-, Russian- and British-made weapons existed side by side and the ammunition calibres were mixed — a single company was often issued rifles of different calibres at once, and the rear area was badly uncoordinated. The Fengtian armies bought their arms in bulk from Japan, and the Type 38 was consequently carried in very large numbers by the Fengtian troops; it therefore became the commonest service rifle on the line in Northeast China during the second phase of the expedition in 1928. After the government forces took over the Fengtian depots, these rifles passed in great quantities into local armed groups in the northeast and remained in use long after the Mukden incident of 1931. Apart from rifles, both sides used hand grenades, mines and light machine guns in quantity, and in siege and defence work the decisive support came from the curved trajectory of mortars while machine-gun fire sealed off the approaches. Cavalry formations were raised mainly in the Fengtian and northwestern armies, whereas the National Revolutionary Army relied on trains and motor lorries, with the Guangzhou–Wuchang railway as the lifeline of supply; a small number of aircraft carried out reconnaissance and ground attack, on a limited scale.
tactics: 北伐全程以粵漢鐵路為縱深主軸。總體採分進合擊：兵分三路——湖南、江西、福建——各路先掃清沿途城鎮，再向武昌、南昌、杭州會合，同時殲滅，避免與敵形成長久的陣線消耗。每一路都在正面攻勢之下派先鋒部隊直插敵縱深與交通樞紐，以切斷對方補給，而不是只求逐點攻佔。湖南線上，獨立團這類小單位以連為單位沿山路與河谷突進，遇阻即側擊迂迴，連續奪取汀泗橋、賀勝橋等鐵路要衝；吳佩孚的反撲集中在地形狹窄的丘陵地帶，北伐軍以迫擊炮曲射壓制敵機槍陣地，再以步兵分波躍進，最終切斷敵軍退往武漢的通道。武漢戰線自十月初兵臨城下至十月二十七日破城，圍城逾二十日，攻城部隊在城牆死角以工兵架雲梯突入，並派兵迂迴城西肅清退路，兩翼同步推進，形成合圍。守軍依托堅固工事與街巷建築逐屋抵抗，北伐軍以爆破與密集手榴彈清除據點。補給方面，糧彈、子彈箱與重火力沿粵漢鐵路北運，後方兵站由韶關經湖南一路向北展開，湖南的糧食與湘贛邊界支線的轉運補足消耗，兵力補充則靠收編地方武裝與歸附部隊。命令與計畫多賴鐵路與驛運傳遞，無線電報已開始在軍級單位使用但覆蓋有限。一九二八年二次北伐改沿津浦鐵路正面北推，先取濟南、再奪德州，北方閻錫山、馮玉祥各部起初按兵不動，待形勢已明才相繼通電順應。
tacticsEn: The whole campaign was conducted along the axis of the Guangzhou–Wuchang railway. Broadly the plan was convergence from separate lines: the army was divided into three columns — through Hunan, through Jiangxi and through Fujian — each clearing the towns along its route before the columns closed on Wuchang, Nanchang and Hangzhou, so that the enemy would be destroyed simultaneously rather than worn down in a long attritional front. On every axis a vanguard detachment was sent into the enemy's depth and towards its transport junctions in order to cut his supply, rather than merely taking place after place. On the Hunan line, small formations such as the Independent Regiment advanced by company along mountain tracks and river valleys, outflanking and turning obstacles, and seized in succession Tingsi Bridge and Hesheng Bridge, the key points of the railway. Wu Peifu's counterattack was concentrated in narrow hill country, where the government troops curved their mortars onto the enemy machine-gun positions and then advanced in waves, until the road by which the northern forces would fall back on Wuhan was cut. On the Wuhan line the siege lasted more than twenty days, from the army's arrival beneath the walls of Wuchang in early October to the breach on 27 October; the assault troops put scaling ladders against the dead ground of the wall with engineer support, while a detachment was sent round to the west of the city to close the escape route, both flanks moving together to form a noose. The garrison, dug into solid works and strong buildings, fought from house to house, and the attackers cleared the strongpoints with demolitions and concentrated hand grenades. On the supply side, grain, ammunition and heavy weapons moved north along the Guangzhou–Wuchang railway, with the depots running from Shaoguan through Hunan to the north; the food of Hunan, together with the branch lines on the Hunan–Jiangxi border, made up the shortfall, and replacements came from local militia and from units that came over. Orders and plans still travelled mostly by rail and by courier, though wireless telegraphy had begun to be used at army level, with limited coverage. The second phase of 1928 ran north along the Tientsin–Pukow railway instead, taking Jinan and then Tezhou, while the armies of Yan Xishan and Feng Yuxiang at first stood still and only declared for the government in turn once the course of events was clear.
data: 可核對的數字集中在時序與規格兩方面。時間上：一九二六年七月九日廣州誓師；七月湘軍倒戈，北伐主力在八月至九月推進至湖北、江西；十月初攻克汀泗橋、賀勝橋；十月二十七日武昌城破，漢口、漢陽此前已入國民革命軍之手，圍城歷時二十餘日。一九二七年三月二十一日國民革命軍進入上海，四月十二日蔣中正宣布清黨，四月十八日南京國民政府成立；一九二八年五月三日奉軍退出北京，北方首都改稱北平；六月三日張作霖在皇姑屯被關東軍所炸身亡；十二月二十九日張學良通電易幟。兵力上，出師時國民革命軍主力約十萬人，多為廣東、湖南及收編部隊；直系吳佩孚可用兵力約二十餘萬；孫傳芳的五省聯軍與奉系關內部隊亦在數十萬之譜。北伐後期國民革命軍總兵力增至數十萬，但其中相當部分是收編而來的雜牌部隊，戰鬥力參差。繳獲方面，汀泗橋、賀勝橋兩戰北伐軍合繳步槍數千支、機槍數百挺、山炮數十門，俘虜以萬計，各家記載數字互有出入。距離與規格方面，粵漢鐵路廣州至武昌約一千公里，是全軍補給的生命線；三八式步槍口徑六點五毫米，五發彈匣，槍重約三點九五公斤，有效射程五百米。
dataEn: The verifiable figures fall into two kinds: chronology and specification. On timing: the oath was taken at Guangzhou on 9 July 1926; the Hunan troops came over in July, and the main body of the army drove into Hubei and Jiangxi between August and September; Tingsi Bridge and Hesheng Bridge were taken in the first days of October; Wuchang fell on 27 October, after more than twenty days of siege, Hankou and Hanyang having already been in government hands. The National Revolutionary Army entered Shanghai on 21 March 1927; Chiang Kai-shek announced the purge on 12 April, and the Nanjing government was formed on 18 April. In 1928 the Fengtian troops left Peking on 3 May and the northern capital was renamed Beiping; Zhang Zuolin was killed by a bomb of the Japanese Kwantung Army at Huangguhtun on 3 June; and Zhang Xueliang declared for the government on 29 December. On strength: the government fielded a main force of roughly 100,000 men at the outset, drawn from Guangdong and Hunan and from units taken over; some 200,000 men were available to Wu Peifu of the Zhili clique; and the Five-Province Allied Army of Sun Chuanfang and the Fengtian forces inside China proper were likewise on the order of several hundred thousand. In the later stages the National Revolutionary Army counted several hundred thousand men, though a substantial share were irregulars taken over, whose fighting quality varied widely. In captures: the two battles of Tingsi and Hesheng yielded the government troops several thousand rifles, several hundred machine guns, dozens of mountain guns and prisoners numbering in the thousands, though the accounts differ from one source to another. On distance and specification: the Guangzhou–Wuchang railway ran about a thousand kilometres and was the army's lifeline of supply, while the Type 38 fires 6.5 mm, carries five rounds in the magazine, weighs about 3.95 kg and has an effective range of 500 metres.
cause: 北伐的起因，是廣州方面與北方軍閥長達十年的對峙終於走向軍事解決。一九二四年孫中山改組國民黨，推行聯俄、聯共、扶助農工三大政策，並在黃埔創辦陸軍軍官學校，同時組織國民革命軍。此後英美等列強在華支持的軍閥分別控制不同省份，關稅與借款抵押予外人，統一的呼聲因此高漲。一九二五年兩次廣州起義在英美支援的敵對軍閥進攻下失敗，孫中山為保存力量，改以軍隊北進取代反叛式的起義，聯俄政策亦轉為蘇聯直接以軍事顧問、貸款與軍火援助國民革命。真正引爆的是湖南：唐生智於一九二六年七月宣布所部改易旗幟加入國民革命軍，北伐軍遂得以在湖南站穩腳跟並開展主戰。與此同時，北方三系並未真正聯合到底：孫傳芳與張作霖曾謀議南北聯合對付吳佩孚，張作霖中途變卦，吳佩孚也想藉機兼併兩家，直系與江浙皖系在江西互相推諉，北伐軍因此得以用分擊各個的辦法逐次取勝。蘇聯與共產國際在政策上支持國民革命的反帝反軍閥口號，並為黃埔系提供軍事顧問與早期經費，美英則在幕後支持吳、孫、張三系，兩股力量在中國的戰場上直接對撞。
causeEn: The Northern Expedition grew out of a decade of confrontation between the Guangzhou side and the northern warlords, which at last was to be settled militarily. In 1924 Sun Yat-sen reorganised the Kuomintang, adopted the three policies of alliance with Russia, alliance with the communists and support for workers and peasants, founded the Whampoa Military Academy at Huangpu and organised the National Revolutionary Army. British and American backing for the warlords had left different provinces in different hands, customs and foreign loans were mortgaged to outsiders, and the cry for unification grew louder. The two uprisings at Guangzhou in 1925 were defeated by warlord forces backed by Britain and the United States; seeking to preserve his strength, Sun then decided to advance north with regular armies instead of staging another rebellion, and the alliance with Russia turned into direct Soviet support through military advisers, credits and arms. What actually set the fuse alight was Hunan: in July 1926 Tang Shengzhi declared that his troops would change flags and join the National Revolutionary Army, giving the expedition a firm footing in Hunan from which the main war could be fought. At the same time the three northern groups never truly closed ranks. Sun Chuanfang and Zhang Zuolin had talked of a north–south alliance against Wu Peifu; Zhang then changed his mind, and Wu himself wanted to swallow the other two, while Zhili and the Jiangsu–Zhejiang–Anhui forces shifted the blame for each other in Jiangxi. That is what allowed the expedition armies to win by striking one at a time. Soviet and Comintern policy supported the anti-imperialist and anti-warlord platform of the national revolution and supplied advisers and early funds to the Whampoa group, while Britain and the United States stood behind Wu, Sun and Zhang behind the scenes, and the two rival blocs met head-on on Chinese battlefields.
impact: 北伐最大的影響是改變了中國的權力結構。吳、孫、張三大軍閥政權在兩年之內相繼崩潰，一九二八年年底的東北易幟使國民政府取得形式上統一全國的名義，中央政權自此有了全國性的框架，也第一次把蒙古、新疆、熱河等邊疆問題與全國政治掛鈎。與此同時，軍閥時代並未真正終結：舊的北洋集團瓦解之後，收編而來的派系化軍隊反而在國民革命軍內部形成中央系、桂系、滇系、湘系、晉系與奉系等長期割據格局，一九三零年的中原大戰正是這套新軍閥結構的第一次全面爆發。一九二七年四月的清黨與寧漢分裂更在國民黨內部造成深遠裂痕，形式統一之下始終存在派系對抗，影響其後對日作戰的組織與指揮。軍事層面上，北伐同時推動了軍隊的近代化：黨代表制、政治工作、軍事教育與新式射擊訓練自黃埔擴散到全國，湘、鄂、贛各省的民團被整編或解散，地方武裝的式微改變了鄉村社會的武力格局。武器層面的後果尤其長久，戰場上大量繳獲的日製三八式步槍與各式舊槍流入地方團體，一直使用到全面抗戰初期，成為抗戰軍隊底子的一部分；而南京政府取得列強對等承認、展開關稅自主談判，也為後來的國際處境打下基礎。
impactEn: The greatest effect of the Northern Expedition was the transformation of the structure of power in China. The three great warlord regimes collapsed in turn within two years, and the declaration at the end of 1928 gave the national government the outward form of unity over the whole country; a central authority acquired a nationwide framework for the first time, and questions of the frontier — Mongolia, Xinjiang, Jehol — were tied into national politics. The warlord era, however, did not truly end: once the old Beiyang group had disintegrated, the irregular forces taken over into the army hardened into long-lived blocs within the National Revolutionary Army — the central, Guangxi, Yunnan, Hunan, Shanxi and Fengtian cliques — and the Central Plains War of 1930 was the first full eruption of that new structure. The purge of April 1927 and the Nanjing–Wuhan split cut deep into the Kuomintang: beneath the outward unity factional conflict persisted, and it affected the organisation and command of the later war against Japan. On the military side the expedition also pushed forward modernisation. The system of party representatives, political work, military education and modern marksmanship training spread from Whampoa across the country; the local militia of Hunan, Hubei and Jiangxi was either incorporated or disbanded, changing the pattern of armed power in the countryside. The consequences in weapons were the longest-lived of all: the large quantities of captured Japanese Type 38 rifles and other old guns dispersed into local groups and were still in service at the beginning of the full-scale war against Japan, forming part of the equipment base of the resistance armies. And the Nanjing government obtained recognition on equal terms from the foreign powers and opened negotiations on tariff autonomy, laying the foundation of its later international position.
result: 戰役以國民革命軍的全面勝利告終，但這勝利並非一次取得，而是分兩期完成。第一期自一九二六年七月至一九二七年八月，武漢三鎮的陷落使吳佩孚直系主力崩潰，他退回河南，勢力自此一落千丈，北方一時以江浙皖系的孫傳芳為最強；第二期自一九二七年年底至一九二八年六月，國民革命軍在浙江、江西擊敗孫傳芳，蔣中正一九二八年再任總司令，二次北伐沿津浦線推進，五月三日奉軍退出北京，張作霖退回關外，張學良在同年年底通電易幟，閻錫山亦在山西易幟，名義上的全國統一於焉完成，首都由武漢遷回南京。各方對戰役損失的數字記載分歧極大，北伐兩期作戰中雙方傷亡與被俘合計以數十萬計，但缺乏可核對的統計，較可信者僅為數個會戰的一次殲滅數量級。軍事上三個軍閥集團覆滅，部隊與地盤被重新分配；政治上國民政府建立了中央權威的外形，同時也把新的派系衝突帶進全國。北伐的成果此後並未走向穩定，而是隨著一九二九年以後的內戰與一九三一年後的對日危機，逐步被消耗殆盡。
resultEn: The campaign ended in complete victory for the National Revolutionary Army, but that victory was not won in a single stroke; it came in two phases. The first, from July 1926 to August 1927, ended with the loss of the three cities of Wuhan, which broke the main Zhili army of Wu Peifu: he fell back to Henan and his strength collapsed from that moment, and for a time the strongest northern force was the Jiangsu–Zhejiang–Anhui army of Sun Chuanfang. The second, from the end of 1927 to June 1928, saw the government armies defeat Sun in Zhejiang and Jiangxi; Chiang Kai-shek became commander-in-chief again in 1928, the second phase of the expedition drove north along the Tientsin–Pukow line, the Fengtian troops left Peking on 3 May and Zhang Zuolin retreated beyond the Great Wall, with Zhang Xueliang declaring for the government at the end of that year and Yan Xishan doing the same in Shanxi, so that nominal national unity was completed and the capital returned from Wuhan to Nanjing. The accounts of the losses differ enormously from one source to another: the dead, wounded and captured on both sides over the two phases run into the hundreds of thousands, but there is no verifiable tally, and the only figures that can be treated with any confidence are the order of magnitude of the annihilations in a handful of major battles. Militarily the three warlord groups were destroyed and troops and territory were redistributed; politically the national government acquired the outward form of a central authority while carrying new factional conflicts into the country as a whole. The fruits of the Northern Expedition did not lead to stability, but were gradually spent in the civil wars that followed from 1929 and in the Japanese crisis that opened with 1931.
